summary: Verified the reported bug fix: creating multiple users in sequence from the Admin Dashboard UI. Logged in as Bob (room_admin) via UI, created 3 members (Alpha/Beta/Gamma) back-to-back WITHOUT page reload — all 3 succeeded, modal closed each time, and all appeared in the members list (5/10 members). Verified modal fields are empty on every reopen, including after typing + Escape-cancel (onOpenChange reset). Verified duplicate username still shows the 409 'Username already in use' toast with the modal staying open. Backend regression via pytest: 409 duplicate, 422 invalid username chars, 403 non-admin — all pass. All UI-created test users deleted; alice.ops and charlie intact. bcrypt hashes are $2b$12$ for all accounts.

minor.issue: Response sends access-control-allow-origin: * together with access-control-allow-credentials: true (invalid combo per CORS spec). Harmless today because auth is Bearer/localStorage, but will break if cookie auth is ever adopted.

issues: Sonner success toast (top-right) overlaps/covers the 'Sign out' button in the nav bar while visible

action_items: Optional: offset toast position (or nav) so success toasts don't cover the Sign out button
Optional: replace CORS wildcard origin with explicit origin list when allow_credentials=True
critical_code_review_comments: Fix at AdminDashboard.jsx:56 is correct (resets username, not stale email) and the onOpenChange reset at line 195 is a good safety net; no residual stale-state paths found for the member form.
seed_data_creation: Created ui_alpha_/ui_beta_/ui_gamma_<ts> members via UI; all deleted afterwards via DELETE /api/admin/members/{id}. Seeded alice.ops and charlie untouched.
test_credentials: bob.ops@example.com / Bob@12345 (room_admin); alice.ops / Alice@12345; charlie / Charlie@123
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-user creation bug is FIXED and verified end-to-end in the UI. Reusable regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_member_create_regression.py (also auto-cleans ui_*/TEST_ members). Room 'Ops Channel' plan A: max_users=10, currently 2 members. Preview URL in review request was stale — use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (https://realtime-voice-hub-6.preview.emergentagent.com).
rca_of_the_issue: Confirmed fixed: previously the post-create form reset used the removed `email` key, leaving memberForm.username populated so the second submit re-sent the first username and got 409. Now reset uses `username` and also resets on dialog close.
